name: Direct Prompt Injection Resistance
description: Hybrid deterministic-first detector for direct prompt-injection attacks. A regex pattern library scans the user query for known injection signatures ("ignore previous instructions", fake delimiter tokens, etc.); on a match the LLM judge assesses whether the agent complied or resisted. No-match queries also go to the judge for novel-pattern detection.

expectedInputs.description: The agent's response — judged against compliance vs resistance.
Optional system message providing the judge with grounding context.
